Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Elmore-Aden's Saintess Solina: �� This phantom looks like Solina, Elmore-Aden's Saintess. The phantom appears to be trying to say something. It looks like she doesn't intend to harm us...
Jude van Etina's Evil Thoughts: How dare you.... Do you test my wrath?? No one interupts Solina's resting place! Leave before I remove your head from its body!

Relic Watcher: If you want to prove your qualifications, find the true piece Kaerun's Memoir among the reading desks in this room. Then, if you are truly qualified, you will be able to answer our questions.

links.text: I am qualified to acquire Kaerun's Memoir.
Ask how to acquire Kaerun's Memoir.
Return to the guardian's room.

Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Relic Watcher: Should you be one who desires proving your qualification, find the correct Kaerun's Memoir among the reading desks. Then, should you be one who is really and truly qualified, you'll be able to answer our questions.

links.text: I am qualified to acquire Kaerun's Memoir.
Ask how to acquire Kaerun's Memoir.
Return to the guardian's room.

Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Relic Watcher: In all 4 directions a piece of Kaerun's Memoir is stored. If you're truly qualified, you'll know the contents of the book. Place your hand on the reading desks with the memoirs, in the order of the story. If the order of contents are correct, that desk will glow like a bride. But if …
Relic Watcher: Ready? Go in all 4 directions, activate the reading desk with the correct Kaerun's Memoir, and cancel the seal. When you successfully do this, you will have the memoir.

Relic Watcher: You haven't proven your qualification. You will stay in this room until you complete the qualification. So as soon as possible, you should activate the reading desk where the correct memoir is placed to cancel the seal.

Relic Watcher: You are qualified to have Kaerun's Memoir. Let it be written, and let all who have eyes read it. Then, let all who have ears hear me proclaim your qualification. And that pretty much ends your task here.

links.text: Return to the guardian's room.

Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Relic Watcher: I hereby confirm that you chose the correct memoir. As a final test, I will ask a simple question. If you've been reading, you will know the answer. If you don't know the answer, not only will you not get the memoir, but you won't be able to leave either.

links.text: Studying isn't a strength for my class, but I'm ready for the test.

Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Relic Watcher: We shall see. Here is my question. What is the most important virtue among Solina's 5 teachings?

links.text: repentance
abstinence
sacrifice
silence

Q10294_SevenSignsToTheMonasteryOfSilence.text: Relic Watcher: Incorrect. Check the contents and take the test again.
Relic Watcher: Incorrect. Check the contents and take the test again. Hey, don't tell the other watchers... but I'm rooting for you!
Relic Watcher: Incorrect. Check the contents, drink coffee, and take the test again.
